newsitem.title: USA: RENAL CARE CREDIT FACILITY UPPED TO $125MLN.
newsitem.headline: RENAL CARE CREDIT FACILITY UPPED TO $125MLN.

text.p: Renal Care Group Inc said Wednesday a consortium of banks has agreed to increase its revolving credit facility to $125 million from $35 million.

The services company said the banks are NationsBank of Tennessee, a unit of NationsBank Corp ; First American National Bank; First Union Bank of Tennessee, a unit of First Union Corp ; and SunTrust Bank.
It said the unsecured facility has a five-year term and provides for prime or LIBOR rate interest options based upon certain financial covenants.
Renal Care Group provides dialysis and ancillary services to kidney disease patients through 102 outpatient centers in 15 states.
